## Summary Implements transfer coverage gap **G4** — `"You'll receive"` rate + countdown timer, quote refresh, and same-currency omission — as `verify-transfer-you-will-receive.spec.ts`, and promotes it to **Flow 23** across the flow docs. > **Renumbered 22 → 23.** #2917 landed Flow 22 for G1 client-side amount validation while this branch was open. Code and docs are consistently Flow 23; an earlier revision of this PR description said Flow 22 and was stale — thanks for catching it. Panel-only: no transfer is ever confirmed, so no balance is consumed and all three tests share one account. **Two judgement calls worth reviewing:** 1. **The gap wording was slightly wrong.** It said `"You'll receive"` is *"absent for same-currency"*. Reading `transfer-content.tsx`, the footer row itself is gated on `bothSelected && showYoullReceive`, which is currency-agnostic — only the **countdown span** and the **converted secondary line** are gated on `!isDisplaySameCurrency`. The spec asserts that precisely: for same-currency the row is still visible, and those two elements have count 0. 2. **`flow.md`'s G4 table was stale.** It described estimate visibility + CoinGecko ±4% tolerance, which is already covered by Flows 9–19 (the gate is embedded in `transferFundsWallet`) plus Flow 20's unit test. `coverage.md` had the correct scope. I rewrote the `flow.md` table to match reality rather than implementing already-covered ground. ## Changes - **New spec** `playwright/tests/transfer/verify-transfer-you-will-receive.spec.ts` — 3 tests: - Cross-currency (USD → TRX): converted estimate, `(s)` countdown matching `^\(\d{1,2}s\)$`, and the From-currency secondary line - Countdown ticks live, then the quote refreshes on the 30s poll - Same-currency (USD wallet → USD Options): amount still shown, countdown and converted line both `toHaveCount(0)` - **`TransferPage`** — 1 locator (`youllReceiveRateCountdown`), 3 actions (`openTransferPanelFromPortfolio`, `getRateCountdownSeconds`, `waitForQuoteRefresh`), 3 verifications (`verifyCrossCurrencyYoullReceive`, `verifyRateCountdownTicks`, `verifySameCurrencyYoullReceive`) - **Flow docs** — G4 promoted to Flow 23 in `flow.md` / `coverage.md` / `catalog.md`; `_index.md` status flipped to `automated` and counts corrected (transfer 26 → 27, total 177 → 178) ### Merge note — a silent count double-bump Both this branch and #2917 independently bumped transfer's Automated count `25 → 26`. Because the resulting lines were **textually identical**, git auto-merged them with no conflict — leaving the count one short now that two flows are automated. Corrected to **27 / 178**, verified by programmatically counting `automated` rows in the module table. Flagging it because this class of error is invisible in a conflict view. ## Type of change - [x] Docs / skills update - [x] New test coverage ## Test plan - [x] `verify-transfer-you-will-receive.spec.ts` — **3/3 passed** on `chromium` (desktop) against staging - [x] `verify-transfer-you-will-receive.spec.ts` — **3/3 passed** on `chromium-mobile` against staging - [x] Re-ran 3/3 on `chromium` **after merging main**, since `TransferPage.ts` had a hand-resolved conflict - [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — no new errors (8 pre-existing missing-module errors in `src/`, untouched here) - [x] `npm run lint` — no output for either changed `.ts` file - [x] `verify-transfer-panel-validation.spec.ts` (from #2917) is **byte-identical to `main`** on this branch — this PR does not touch it - [x] No conflict markers anywhere in `playwright/`; no duplicate flow numbers in the transfer docs - [x] Nothing outside `playwright/` modified - [ ] Reviewer check: the negative assertions in test 3 are **not vacuous** — test 1 asserts the same two locators positively, which proves they resolve when the countdown exists **Playwright impact:** adds 1 new spec (3 tests, `@desktop @mobile @transfer`). No existing spec's behaviour, selectors, or copy changed; `TransferPage` additions are purely additive. ## Notes for reviewers - **`youllReceiveRateCountdown` is a positional locator** (`locator("span")`) because the countdown span has no `data-testid`. Correct today — that `

` contains exactly one `` — but fragile if the line gains another. A `TODO` is now recorded on the getter proposing `data-testid="transfer-text-rate-countdown"` as a follow-up; the source edit needs sign-off per the `playwright/CLAUDE.md` scope rule, so it wasn't made here. **Happy to add it in this PR if a reviewer approves touching `src/`.** - `verifyRateCountdownTicks` asserts the countdown **changes** rather than strictly decreases. The timer wraps 1 → 30 (`setRateCountdown(c => (c <= 1 ? 30 : c - 1))`), so a poll straddling the wrap would observe an increase — a "must decrease" assertion would flake roughly once every 30 runs. - `waitForQuoteRefresh` matches on `destination=` because the separate from→primary-fiat rate lookup hits the same `/api/deriv/exchange-rate` endpoint. - New env var `TEST_TRANSFER_YOULL_RECEIVE_EMAIL` (backup account) — optional; `createAccountV2viaJS` generates a fresh account when unset. ## Related issues / PRs - #2917 — landed Flow 22 (G1 client-side amount validation); this PR merged it in and renumbered to Flow 23 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: test(transfer): cover "You'll receive" rate + countdown (G4 → Flow 23)

## Summary

- Adds `playwright/tests/auth/verify-social-login-redirect-lock.spec.ts` implementing gap **G7** from `playwright/flows/auth/coverage.md`: the social-provider redirect lock (`SocialLoginButtons` / `useAuthMethodBusy`) had no e2e coverage.
- New **throttled-redirect harness**: intercepts the Kratos flow-update POST (`self-service/login?flow=`) via `page.route()`, forwards it to the real upstream with `route.fetch()`, then delays fulfillment with `route.fulfill({ response })`. This widens the mid-redirect window deterministically so the lock state is reliably assertable before `initSocialAuth`'s `window.location.assign()` fires — without it, the real redirect can resolve too fast to observe.
- Two tests, both passing on `chromium` + `chromium-mobile` against staging:
  1. Clicking Social Sandbox (Test) shows its spinner and `aria-busy="true"`, disables Google/Facebook/Apple (`aria-disabled="true"`), suppresses a mid-redirect click on another provider (dispatched directly since the button is natively `disabled`), and only releases once the browser navigates to the mock IDP (`*.projects.oryapis.com`).
  2. Forcing the same POST to fail (500) confirms the non-redirect (error) outcome re-enables all buttons for retry.
- No account provisioning needed — Social Sandbox returns `redirect_browser_to` for an anonymous login attempt regardless of whether the identity is linked, so the mock IDP is reachable directly.
- Added `LoginPage.socialSandboxSpinner` getter (locators-first convention).
- Flow docs (`flow.md`, `catalog.md`, `coverage.md`, `_index.md`) promote G7 to **Flow 21 / 21.1**, synced against `test/g8-client-lookup-uae-mock` (which already carries `test/g9`'s edits) rather than `main`, so this doesn't collide with G8/G9's Flow 19/20 slots whichever order these land in.

## Summary

- Raises the npm overrides floor for `brace-expansion`, closing the 9 open Dependabot alerts for it (#99, #100, #101, #106, #107, #108, #109, #110, #111) — DoS via unbounded/exponential-time brace expansion.
- `brace-expansion` isn't a direct dependency; it's pulled in transitively by `minimatch` across three semver-incompatible major lines, each requiring its own scoped override so the fix doesn't collapse everything onto one incompatible major:

| Chain | Instance | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eslint` → `minimatch@3.1.5` | `node_modules/brace-expansion` | 1.1.15 | **1.1.18** |
| `@opennextjs/aws` → `@node-minify/core` → `glob@9.3.5` → `minimatch@8.0.7` | `@node-minify/core/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 2.1.1 | **2.1.4** |
| `@opennextjs/cloudflare` → `glob@12.0.0` → `minimatch@10.2.5` | `glob/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 5.0.6 | **5.0.9** |
| `@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree` → `minimatch@10.2.5` | `@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree/node_modules/brace-expansion` | 5.0.6 | **5.0.9** |

All four are dev-tooling-only (eslint, opennextjs build tooling, typescript-eslint) — no production runtime code path touches `brace-expansion`. Follow-up to #2940, which explicitly left this dependency for a separate PR.

`npm audit` no longer lists `brace-expansion`; total high-severity count dropped 3→2.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run lint` — 0 errors (45 pre-existing warnings, unrelated)
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean
- [x] `npm run test` — 2868/2869 passing; the 1 failure (`kratos-client.test.ts` timeout) is confirmed pre-existing/flaky — reproduced independently on a clean `main` checkout with *more* failures (10), and passes in isolation in 1.2s
- [x] Verified via `package-lock.json` diff that each `brace-expansion` instance now resolves to the exact `first_patched_version` from its corresponding Dependabot alert, without disturbing any other package

## What

`TncUpdateGate` mounts globally in the root layout (`src/app/layout.tsx`) and runs on **every** authenticated route. Since a user must be logged in to reach `/oauth2/consent`, a pending TNC update would pop the **non-dismissible** `TncUpdateModal` over the consent screen and block the third-party **Allow / Deny** handoff.

This adds a render guard so the modal is never surfaced on the consent route.

## How

```tsx
const isOAuth2ConsentPath =
  pathname === ROUTES.OAUTH2_CONSENT ||
  pathname.startsWith(`${ROUTES.OAUTH2_CONSENT}/`);
if (isOAuth2ConsentPath) return null;
```

- Uses the live `pathname` (basePath already stripped), matching the existing `/oauth2` exemption in the sibling `RestrictedCountryGate`.
- The TNC check itself is left untouched — it still runs, so the modal surfaces on the **next in-app route** if an update is genuinely pending.
- The only consumers of the TNC store flags (`home-view.tsx`) are not on the consent route, so nudge sequencing is unaffected.

## Testing

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean.
- `npm run lint` — no new issues (the 6 pre-existing `require()` errors are in unrelated files, identical on the branch base).
- Related unit tests pass (94 oauth2-consent / tnc tests).

## Playwright impact

0 specs updated, 2 flow docs updated, 1 gap filed (**G12** in `playwright/flows/auth/coverage.md`), 0 regressions flagged. No existing spec asserts the TNC modal on our `/oauth2/consent` route (social-sandbox specs drive the *external* mock-IDP consent; the deposit spec exercises the modal only on the home/deposit route). Synced `playwright/flows/_index.md` counts (auth 39→40, total 327→328).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: fix(oauth2): suppress TNC update modal on /oauth2/consent screen

## Summary

Fixes two of the packages flagged on the [Dependabot alerts page](https://github.com/deriv-com/home-app/security/dependabot) by raising the existing `overrides` floor in `package.json`. Both are production-scope (runtime) dependencies:

| Package | Was | Now | Alerts fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dompurify` | 3.4.9 (transitive via `jspdf`, `posthog-js`) | 3.4.13 | [#118](https://github.com/deriv-com/home-app/security/dependabot/118) (medium, XSS via `IN_PLACE` hook removal), [#104](https://github.com/deriv-com/home-app/security/dependabot/104) (low), [#94](https://github.com/deriv-com/home-app/security/dependabot/94) (medium, `ALLOWED_ATTR` pollution) |
| `postcss` | 8.5.21 | 8.5.26 | [#112](https://github.com/deriv-com/home-app/security/dependabot/112) (medium, arbitrary `.map` file read via attacker-controlled `sourceMappingURL`) |

Both bumps are within the semver ranges already declared by their dependents (`jspdf@^3.3.1`, `posthog-js@^3.3.2`, and the existing `postcss` override itself), so no other package needed touching. `dompurify` didn't have an override before — added one so future transitive resolutions stay patched.

## Why only these two

The Dependabot page also flags `js-yaml`, `undici`, `brace-expansion`, and `body-parser` — all dev-tooling-only transitive deps (eslint, wrangler/miniflare, lint/test tooling), not shipped to users. `undici` in particular is pinned to an exact version by `miniflare`, so fixing it needs a `wrangler`/`miniflare` upgrade rather than a simple override — left as a follow-up rather than bundling a bigger, riskier bump with this one.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run lint` — 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only, unrelated to this change)
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean
- [x] `npm run test` — 304/304 test files, 2869/2869 tests passing
- [x] `npm audit` confirms `dompurify` and `postcss` no longer appear in the vulnerability list
title: fix(deps): bump dompurify and postcss to patched versions
